name: Logikcull
description: Logikcull is a self-service eDiscovery platform from Reveal for collecting, processing, culling, searching, reviewing, producing, and reporting on litigation and investigation data. It supports cloud collections, project-based review, search syntax, reports, productions, legal hold workflows, GenAI-assisted search, and security controls for sensitive legal evidence.
agentUseSummary: Logikcull is visible as a preview-only Marketplace entry. Official materials document product workflows, UI reporting, search syntax, usage reporting, activity logs, processing reports, and source integrations, but do not publish a stable customer API, OAuth, endpoint, scope, webhook, sandbox, rate-limit, or production acceptance contract Relay can safely implement.

capabilities.label: Coordinate e-discovery operations
capabilities.description: Preview a future provider-approved, least-privilege Logikcull integration surface without assuming access to projects, uploads, searches, documents, reports, productions, legal holds, AI results, or administration.

blocked.label: Connect without a Logikcull API contract
blocked.description: Relay will not accept credentials or create a connection until Logikcull supplies or approves the exact authentication model, tenant/project binding, endpoints, scopes, rate limits, audit obligations, sandbox, disconnect behavior, and production acceptance process.

blocked.label: Access project, user, or account data
blocked.description: Accounts, projects, matters, clients, users, roles, permissions, account settings, usage reports, activity logs, access expiration, SSO, 2FA, and audit data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Access documents, collections, review, AI, or productions
blocked.description: Cloud collections, uploads, custodians, documents, metadata, search results, tags, notes, redactions, processing reports, productions, privilege logs, ASK/GenAI prompts or outputs, and legal data remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use UI sessions, integrations, exports, or admin bypass
blocked.description: Browser sessions, cookies, passwords, provider consoles, Slack/Google/Microsoft/Onna integrations, report downloads, raw UI endpoints, scraping, undocumented APIs, pagination, polling, bulk, exports, writes, and administration are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Provider API contract required
approvalProfiles.description: No agent action is callable until Logikcull/Reveal and the exact customer account authorize a least-privilege Relay integration and live acceptance boundary.

runtimeSupport.description: Logikcull remains visible for discovery, but no OpenClaw tools are callable before a provider-approved API/authentication contract, customer account authorization, least-privilege design, and live acceptance.

Logikcull remains visible for discovery, but no Hermes tools are callable before a provider-approved API/authentication contract, customer account authorization, least-privilege design, and live acceptance.

providerSetup.blocker: Logikcull public materials describe product workflows and help-center UI operations, but do not publish the exact customer API, OAuth, endpoint, scope, webhook, sandbox, rate-limit, or production acceptance contract Relay requires.
providerSetup.nextAction: Obtain Logikcull/Reveal approval for a customer-safe API contract. Define the authentication model, tenant/project binding, approved read and write endpoints, legal-data redaction boundary, rate limits, audit obligations, sandbox, disconnect behavior, and live acceptance before implementing runtime tools.

evidence.supports: Logikcull describes eDiscovery workflows for collections, uploads, processing, culling, search, review, production, GenAI/ASK, reports, permissions, audit monitoring, encryption, and source integrations.
Logikcull support documents search syntax and UI-driven CSV report exports, indicating sensitive project/document search results without publishing a Relay-callable API contract.
Logikcull support documents account-owner/admin usage reporting over account and project statistics, downloadable through the UI rather than a public API.

Logikcull support documents a Slack Discovery API integration controlled through Logikcull UI workflows and Slack Org Owner credentials, which Relay must not repurpose as a generic Logikcull connector.

securityNotes: No Logikcull account, project, credential, cookie, browser session, Slack/Google/Microsoft integration credential, document, report, production, usage row, or legal data was collected or tested.
Relay will not automate Logikcull browser UI flows, report downloads, cloud upload forms, source integrations, or private endpoints as a substitute for a provider-approved API contract.
Search, review, processing, production, usage, activity-log, legal-hold, GenAI/ASK, upload, collection, export, administration, raw API, pagination, bulk, and write operations remain unavailable.

Because Logikcull handles highly sensitive legal discovery data, any future connector must be exact-account authorized, least-privilege, fully audited, response-bounded, redacted, and accepted with customer and provider security review.
